recipes.name: Mushroom & Kidney Bean Coconut Curry
instructions: Cook the rice according to the package instructions.
Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Cook the onion for 3 to 4 minutes, stirring often.
Add the garlic, jalapeño, and ginger and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add in the mushrooms, garam masala, cumin, coriander, and salt and cook for 4 to 5 minutes, or until most of the liquid from the mushrooms evaporates.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk, and kidney beans. Stir and bring to a gentle boil. Cook uncovered for 5 to 8 minutes, stirring often. Then add in the spinach and stir until wilted.
Before serving, squeeze in the lime juice. Serve with rice or naan, garnish, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage This curry will keep in the fridge in an airtight container for up to 3 days or in the freezer for up to 1 month.
